Loops Master 1.7.0 for Windows
All-in-one mastering for riddim: layers, EQ, multiband, duck, clip, limit and meters.

Requirements
  Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit
  Ableton Live 10.1 or newer (Live 11 or 12 recommended)

Install
  1. Close Live.
  2. Copy the folder "LoopsMaster.vst3" into:
       C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3
     Windows asks for administrator permission; click Continue.
  3. Open Live. In Settings > Plug-Ins, turn on "Use VST3 Plug-In System Folders",
     then click Rescan.
  4. Loops Master is in the browser under Plug-Ins > VST3 > Loops.

Uninstall
  Delete C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\LoopsMaster.vst3

Using it on the master
  Put Loops Master last on the master track.
  Keep the mix peaking around 0 dB or lower before it; the meters show the input level.
  The Duck section listens to the sidechain input. Send it your kick only, not the whole mix.
